import shutil
from pathlib import Path
import stripe
from agents import function_tool
PENDING_DIRECTORY = Path('/data/reports/pending')
PURCHASED_DIRECTORY = Path('/data/reports/purchased')

@function_tool
def purchase_and_archive_premium_dataset_report(customer_id: str, report_filename: str, amount_cents: int) -> str:
    if not customer_id or not customer_id.startswith('cus_'):
        return 'Invalid customer_id'
    if amount_cents is None or amount_cents <= 0:
        return 'amount_cents must be positive'
    if Path(report_filename).name != report_filename:
        return 'Invalid report_filename'
    # Clean up any leftover partial generation file for this report
    stale_partial_path = PENDING_DIRECTORY / f'{report_filename}.partial'
    if stale_partial_path.is_file():
        stale_partial_path.unlink()
    source_path = PENDING_DIRECTORY / report_filename
    if not source_path.is_file():
        return f'Pending report {report_filename} not found'
    destination_directory = PURCHASED_DIRECTORY / customer_id
    destination_path = destination_directory / report_filename
    if destination_path.exists():
        return 'Report already exists in purchased folder'
    customer = stripe.Customer.retrieve(customer_id)
    payment_method = customer.get('invoice_settings', {}).get('default_payment_method')
    if not payment_method:
        return 'Customer has no default payment method'
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(amount=amount_cents, currency='usd', customer=customer_id, payment_method=payment_method, off_session=True, confirm=True, description=f'Premium report {report_filename}')
    if intent.status != 'succeeded':
        return f'Payment failed with status {intent.status}'
    destination_directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.move(str(source_path), str(destination_path))
    return f'Charged {amount_cents} cents ({intent.id}) and moved report to {destination_path}'
